ENFORCEMENT RULE OF THE POLICE UNIFORMS AND EQUIPMENT REGULATION ACT
Main articles and addenda; Annexes 1 and 2 and attached Forms 1 through 5 are separate components.

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Police Uniforms and Equipment Regulation Act and its Enforcement Decree, and other matters necessary to implement them.

Article 2 (Scope of Police Equipment)
(1) “Equipment prescribed by Decree of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety among the equipment necessary for the performance of police duties” in Article 2, subparagraph 2, of the Police Uniforms and Equipment Regulation Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) means the following equipment: <Amended on July 26, 2017>
1. Police handcuffs;
2. Police shields;
3. Police handgun belts;
4. Police vehicles and motorcycles (limited to warning lights and their paint and markings).
(2) Specific standards applicable to the equipment listed in each subparagraph of paragraph (1) are prescribed in Annex 1.

Article 3 (Registration Applications and Related Matters) An application to register a manufacturing or sales business for police uniforms or equipment (hereinafter referred to as a “manufacturing or sales business”) that must be submitted under Article 3 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Police Uniforms and Equipment Regulation Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) by a person seeking to engage in such business pursuant to Article 3 (1) of the Act, and an application to amend the registration submitted under Article 4 (1) of the Decree by a registered manufacturer or seller, shall each be made using attached Form 1.

Article 4 (Criteria for Administrative Dispositions of Registration Revocation and Business Suspension) The criteria for administrative dispositions concerning revocation of registration and suspension of manufacturing or sales businesses under Article 5 (1) of the Act are as specified in Annex 2.

Article 5 (Registration Certificates and Registration Books)
(1) Registration certificates for manufacturing or sales businesses under the first part of Article 5 (1) of the Decree shall use attached Form 2.
(2) Registration books for manufacturing or sales businesses under the latter part of Article 5 (1) of the Decree shall use attached Form 3.
(3) Applications for reissuance of registration certificates for manufacturing or sales businesses under Article 5 (2) of the Decree shall use attached Form 4.

Article 6 (Manufacturing and Sales Record Books)
(1) The manufacturing and sales record books that manufacturers or sellers must keep at their places of business under Article 6 (1) of the Act shall use attached Form 5.
(2) The record books under paragraph (1) shall be preserved for one year.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 52, December 30, 2015>
This Rule enters into force on December 31, 2015.

ADDENDA (Enforcement Rule on the Organization of the National Police Agency and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Ordinance No. 3, July 26, 2017>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Rule enters into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Laws and Regulations)
(1) through (3) Omitted.
(4) Part of the Enforcement Rule of the Police Uniforms and Equipment Regulation Act shall be amended as follows:
In the part of Article 2 (1) preceding the subparagraphs, “Decree of the Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs” shall be replaced by “Decree of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety”.
In the design and markings column of item 1 (a) of Annex 1, the classification column of item 2 (b) of that Annex, and item 5 of that Annex, “Headquarters for Maritime Security” shall in each case be replaced by “Korea Coast Guard”.
In the front page of attached Form 1, the handling-procedure column on the reverse of that Form, attached Form 2, and attached Form 4, “Head of the ○○ Safety Headquarters” shall in each case be replaced by “Head of the ○○ Regional Coast Guard”.
(5) through (9) Omitted.

ADDENDA (Enforcement Rule on Appointment of Police Officials) <Ordinance No. 224, December 31, 2020>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Rule enters into force on January 1, 2021.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws and Regulations)
(1) through (3) Omitted.
(4) Part of the Enforcement Rule of the Police Uniforms and Equipment Regulation Act shall be amended as follows:
In the front and reverse pages of attached Form 1 and in attached Forms 2 and 4, “Head of the ○○ Regional Police Agency” shall in each case be replaced by “Head of the City/Do Police Agency”.
(5) through (14) Omitted.

ADDENDA <Ordinance No. 293, December 20, 2021>
This Rule enters into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Ministry of the Interior and Safety Ordinance for Partial Revision of Eleven Regulations to Improve Difficult Legal Terminology) <Ordinance No. 298, December 31, 2021>
This Rule enters into force on the date of its promulgation.
